Hægt verður að skrá sig á staðnum en eingöngu í 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx og Skewb
Dagskráin gæti breyst aðeins áður en mót hefst. Ef enginn skráir sig í 4BLD þá dettur það út.

On the spot registrations will only be allowed for 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb.
The schedule might change a bit before the competition starts, mainly if nobody registers for 4BLD it will be cancelled.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBckZKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fc7e4be683d207d36adaf04797dc31edb2c430f0/364219859_653473463379948_1087857804782019580_n.jpg)

¡Speed Cubing Fest 2023: Despierta al Competidor en ti!

¡Amantes del desafío y los colores vibrantes!

Te invitamos al emocionante Torneo de Speed Cubing, donde la pasión por los rompecabezas y las nuevas experiencias se unen en una jornada llena de giros y vueltas. ¿Eres un novato listo para descubrir tu potencial? ¿Un competidor inactivo en busca de un nuevo reto? ¿Un experimentado de los cubos ansioso por llevar al límite tus habilidades? ¡Este es tu momento!

Ven a superar el desafío que te espera en la ciudad de los pastes.

Speedcubing Fest Pachuca 2023 es una competencia oficial de la WCA y todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Lovers of challenge and vibrant colors!

We invite you to the exciting Speed Cubing competition, where the passion for puzzles and new experiences come together in a journey full of twists and turns. Are you a newbie ready to discover your potential? An inactive competitor looking for a new challenge? An experienced cuber eager to push your skills to the limit? This is your moment!

Come meet the challenge that awaits you in the city of pastes.

Speedcubing Fest 2023 is an official WCA competition and all the competitors must be familiarized with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)

venue.name: Mather Campground
venue.address: 1 Mather Campground Rd, Grand Canyon Village, AZ 86023

items.information:
# This competition is intended to be an overnight competition/camping trip. We ask that you please only register if you intend on staying overnight. This event spans over three days (two nights).
# 

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/InTentsCubingGrandCanyon2023#27839-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
